title: v2.1.318
excerpt: What's changed Added a record of your answer when Claude Code asks to turn on the mods it writes in a session Added assume_role on mantle upstreams of the Claude apps gateway, for a role in another AWS account and for per-developer AWS cost attribution Added an effort option to a mod's $.model.fork , so a quick side job can run at low whatever effort the session uses; the result reports the effort sent Added the date a stored claude.ai sign-in ends to claude auth status ( loginExpiresAt ) and to claude -p JSON results ( credential_expires_at ) Added a one-line stderr warning to claude -p text output, starting 10 days before a stored claude.ai sign-in ends Fixed --continue sometimes losing the earlier conversation after a malformed tool call's retries ran out (regression in 2.1.314) Fixed macOS sessions with many running Bash commands stalling while memory grew Fixed permission prompts being answered by keys typed just after sending a message, or before a slow prompt appeared Fixed /logout , claude auth logout and claude mcp remove reporting success, and changes to trust, consent or MCP settings being dropped with no word, when the config file could not be updated on a shared network home directory Fixed jobs exiting with Not logged in when another terminal or host signs in again to the same account and organization on the same home Fixed claude mcp add and remove writing the config without its lock: they now wait for it or exit 1, though another job's save can still replace a
